subject: CypherSec pen-test: scope amendment request and access plan
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: expanded scope + proposed test window (Sep 15-17)

Hi Mina / Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Following our discovery call, attached is an updated SOW proposing an expanded scope that includes:
- Public web app (www.app.redwood.com) + staging subdomain
- Internal REST API endpoints behind the API gateway (read-only subset for testing)
- One backend microservice (metrics-ingest) reachable from the staging VPC

We propose a test window of Sep 15-17 (3 business days) with a single point-of-contact from Redwood for access issues. To proceed we need:
1) Confirmation of the test window (or alternatives)
2) IP allowlist ranges we'll be testing from (we're using 34.72.10.0/24 and 35.201.45.0/24)
3) Staging credentials or a time-limited service account and any jump host instructions

I've attached the proposed SOW (CypherSec_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short questionnaire. If you prefer a different window or want to exclude any host, we can amend the annex.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Senior Engagement Lead | CypherSec Labs
alex.moreno@cyphersec.com
(415) 555-0173

Attachment: CypherSec_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 198 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: expanded scope + proposed test window (Sep 15-17)

Alex — thanks, received. A few quick clarifications before we lock the window:

- Authentication: for the staging app we'll provide a time-limited API key (read-only) and a staging user account. For the internal API endpoints, read-only DB credentials are acceptable but we prefer queries routed to a read-replica.
- Network: your test IPs above look fine; we'll add to the allowlist.
- Jump host: we will provide a bastion (ssh) for access to the metrics-ingest service; will that work or do you need VPN?

Vivek — can you confirm the compliance-side guardrails (log retention snapshot, monitoring alert thresholds) and whether we need to schedule log export snapshots during the window?

I'll drop the staging access details in a follow-up with the service account expiry and exact bastion hostname.

Mina Haddad
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: staging-access-details.txt (text/plain, 2 KB)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, ops@cyphersec.com
Date: 2026-09-02T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: expanded scope + proposed test window (Sep 15-17)

Thanks Mina — read-replica and time-limited creds are perfect. Two small scope notes from our side:

1) We recommend inclusion of the feature-flag service (flags.redwood.com) in discovery; it touches auth and rollout controls and often surfaces horizontal privilege issues. Can you confirm whether to include?
2) For DB access, we will only run non-destructive read queries unless you explicitly allow a limited write test (not recommended).

If you confirm the feature-flag service and the read-only approach, we'll push an annex update. Otherwise, we'll proceed as-is.

Alex

Attachment: scope-annex-v2.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Access plan, allowlist, and test rules

Alex / team — team note and acceptance:

- Include feature-flag service in the scope (flags.redwood.com).
- IP allowlist entries: 34.72.10.0/24, 35.201.45.0/24 (we'll add to security groups and WAF rules by Sep 10 COB).
- Bastion: ssh jump at bastion-stage.redwood.internal (we will provide one-time SSH certs via our CA)
- DB: read-only user on the read-replica (no write permissions) with query limits enforced by a max-exec-time policy.
- Logs: We'll snapshot logs (auth + app + WAF) at 00:00 UTC on each test day and export to the audit bucket (link below). Please limit noisy scanning during the first two hours to allow baseline sampling.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Test window: Sep 15 09:00 PDT — Sep 17 18:00 PDT (primary); Sep 18 reserved for follow-ups.
- Preliminary findings: draft within 5 business days after the end of the window.
- Final report: 10 business days post-window with remediation recommendations.

Access artifacts will be delivered via the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pen-test-access (we will put keys and the bastion CA bundle there).

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: access-keys-expiry-policy.txt (text/plain, 1 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access plan, allowlist, and test rules — confirmation and reporting expectations

All — we're aligned on scope and access (flags service included). A couple of operational asks before the window: 

- Please confirm the format of the preliminary findings (doc vs spreadsheet) so our triage team can ingest quickly. We prefer a CSV for findings plus a short executive summary (one page).
- Confirm whether vulnerability severity will follow CVSSv3 scoring (yes/no).
- Please share POC contacts for any live-risk items outside the test window.

Aditya — looping you in for commercial terms; if CypherSec will need scope amendments after testing, we should pre-agree a change order process.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cyphersec.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cyphersec.com, ops@cyphersec.com
Date: 2026-09-10T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access plan, allowlist, and test rules — confirmation and reporting expectations

Mina / Vivek — confirmed on all counts: 

- Preliminary findings: we will deliver a CSV export of findings (columns: finding_id, severity_cvssv3, affected_host, path, remediations) plus a one-page executive summary in PDF within 5 business days.
- We will use CVSSv3 for severity scoring and include PoC contact info for high/critical items in the preliminary artifact.
- Final report delivery: targeted Sep 29, 2026 (10 business days post-window).
- Change orders: contracts@cyphersec.com (cc'd) will issue any scope amendment quotes within 48 hours of request. Expect an invoice for the base engagement next week.

Thanks — looking forward to working with the Redwood infra/security teams.

Alex Moreno
Senior Engagement Lead | CypherSec Labs

Attachment: invoice-#4472.pdf (application/pdf, 12 KB)
